column3: Kirino Route · I Have To Ask Tamura Manami For Help
The last day of the three day holiday. Once again, I felt terrible when I woke up today.
*sigh*... How depressing.
...It has already been five days since I've learned that Kirino lost her memories, you see.
Why hasn't Kirino recovered her memories yet?
Furthermore, I end up being hated by Kirino each time I fail to help.
It's awkward whenever I run into Kirino now.
*sigh*... What should I do?
...I'll try getting in touch with Manami.
Kyou-chan, are you all right? You look like you're not feeling too well...
Is that so?
Yes. Your voice sounded weird too when you called me.
Sorry to have worried you, Granny.
No, no. We help each other.
Heh, come to think of it, that rockstar without family or friends little brother of yours, what happened to him after that?
That has been quietly resolved.
That was rather quick.
Yes, he immediately returned to his normal self after being severely lectured by Dad.
By that old man? He's really nice to me and doesn't give any impression of him being scary, though.
Hmm～, Dad was very scary at that time, saying something about how one mustn't treat one's family as strangers even as a joke.
W-Well, that's true. I guess people would normally be angry at that.
Ahh... All my troubles would be gone if I could preach to Kirino like that.
I would definitely die instantly from her retaliation the instant after I did so, though.
Oh, Kyou-chan, what's wrong?
Although I can't go into too much detail... Recently, Kirino has been saying similar things to me.
...Even though I don't completely understand, maybe you'll feel better if you talk to me about it?
That's true... It might be good to rely on granny's bag of wisdom.
Should I... try telling her about it?
...Err.
Because you hold Kirino dear, it's hard to talk about it, right?
Well, just lift your spirits up. Kirino-chan surely understands that you're worried about her.
I-It's not like I'm worried or anything
Hehehe.
Guh, putting on that smiling face.
At times like these, a childhood friend is truly bothersome. But...
...Thanks, Manami.
Well, about Kirino... she started treating me like a stranger right after I came back from the school trip.
It's exactly the same as with Rock.
So that's it... I think Kirino-chan probably has no ill intent behind it like my little brother.
Meaning?
The house was left empty for quite some time when we went on the school trip, right?
Isn't it lonely? And then, she wants you to care about her when you met again after several days...
So she's speaking the opposite of her feelings, that's how I think.
Well, that might be the case with Rock.
That guy, he was a terrible siscon up until a few years back.
But, Kirino is different.
...Is that so.
I think Kirino-chan surely treats Kyou-chan...
...as a 【truly important person】.
【Truly important person】? Is that what Kirino... thinks of me?
...That really is impossible. What is she saying?
But, well...
Thank you, Manami.
Like I thought, I can't explain everything, but... I'll try talking to her about it.
This is just an example, but...
Yes, yes.
Kirino has forgotten everything that happened during the past year.
Kirino-chan has amnesia?
It's just an example. Think of it like that and listen.
Kirino has amnesia--and our relationship, which I thought had finally improved a little over this past year, has gone back to how it was a year ago.
My little sister doesn't think of me as her brother and looks at me as if I'm a stranger.
Obviously, I intend to do all I can to bring back Kirino's memories.
But... as expected, I feel depressed about it.
...Like I said, this is just an example, okay?
While saying it was just an example, I went and told her almost everything.
...I see.
...I don't think the relationship between you and Kirino-chan has gone back to how it was a year ago.
...What do you mean?
Even if Kirino-chan's memories are gone...
You remember the time you spent with Kirino-chan, right?
That's why it hasn't gone back to what it was like before.
...That may be so.
At the very least, it's different from a year ago.
What I obtained during this year with Kirino.
Even if her memories are gone... they won't disappear.
Even now, they're still within me.
...Thanks, Manami.
Yeah.
Also... This is just a guess, but...
Yes?
The Kirino-chan from a year ago also didn't think of Kyou-chan as a stranger.
Haha.
You might be trying to cheer me with that, but that's just not possible.
...I wonder about that.
Kirino-chan surely thinks of you...
As a 【real brother】.
